# Heading 1

Normal paragraph with *emphasis*, **strong**, [a link](https://example.com) and `inline code`.

## Inline math

$\phi_\varepsilon$ and $\partial_\mu\phi$ should not become Markdown emphasis.

Relations: $a \leq b$, $a \geq b$, $a \equiv b$, $a \approx b$, $a \ll b$.

Special fonts/accents: $\mathcal{L}$, $\mathbf{v}$, $\hat{\phi}$, $\tilde{\phi}$.

Functions: $\sin(x)$, $\cos(x)$, $\ln(x)$, $\exp(x)$, $\lim_{x\to0}$.

## Display math

$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta S
&=\int d^4x\,
\frac{\partial\mathcal L}{\partial\phi}\eta\\
&+\int d^4x\,
\frac{\partial\mathcal L}{\partial(\partial_\mu\phi)}
\partial_\mu\eta.
\end{aligned}
$$
